newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end steady to lower in quiet day.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end steady to lower in quiet day.

text.p: March 31 - U.S. debt futures ended steady to lower in very quiet trading, with the long end sagging near session lows late. One analyst said short-covering and bargain hunting amid oversold conditions supported market much of the day, but buyers liquidated late. Trade nervous ahead of March NAPM and employment later this week, traders said.
